text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
You're so cool, Brian! Ahhh, look over
here!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...If we leave now, we can probably
catch an
earlier bullet train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her attitude, Narita Brian has
another
amazing race today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she keeps it up, she'll likely do well at
the
spring Tenno Sho as well.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
choice_data_list: Sorry, I was just lost in thought...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Today's race was so good! Hey,
are you
going to race in the spring
Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I heard a rumor that the Sable
Assassin is
going to be there! The racer
with black hair and a
blue rose—Rice
Shower!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She's been an obstacle for both Mihono
Bourbon
and Mejiro McQueen, so, yeah,
I'd say she's
pretty strong!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
But we're rooting for you, so take her
down for us!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I know training resumes
tomorrow, but I'd
like you to make some
adjustments for the spring
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If there's someone strong enough
to be
called "the assassin," then I
definitely want to see
what she's got.
choice_data_list: You're registering for the Tenno Sho (Spring), right?
You're registering for the Tenno Sho (Spring), aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't just want to see what she's
got. I want
to beat her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Black hair and a blue rose... There's no
mistaking
that she matches the
characteristics of the Sable
Assassin
we've heard rumors of.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's true, "Sable Assassin" hardly seems
like a
fitting name for such a petite and
dainty girl.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But it won't be until the spring Tenno
Sho that
we'll be able to see her
strength with our own
eyes.
